checks.name: Calendar ranges remain stable across month, leap-day and week boundaries
Business-zone day/time conversion and overnight events never invent a time
Conflict model reports real timed overlaps and ignores untimed or finished batches
Real Calendar component switches Month, Week, Day and Agenda while preserving original event titles
Calendar shared search and type filters are sent to range-bound server requests
Event selection fetches the exact original source; rescheduling submits the original ID and concurrency snapshot
Mobile defaults to Agenda and all four languages translate Calendar controls without changing business content
Operations navigation and source actions preserve role gates and use original modules

scope: Model, React component, source/permission contract checks; database and live browser evidence are separate
